import random,sys
from fractions import Fraction
sys.path.insert(0,'.')
import pipeline
from offline_discovery.rule_generate import Cluster, real_prefix

def brute_hits(cl,rng,vals):
 real=real_prefix(vals); L=len(rng)
 if len(real)<L:return False
 for s in range(len(real)-L+1):
  if all(rng[j][0]<=real[s+j]<=rng[j][1] for j in range(L)):return True
 return False
for trial in range(500):
 classes=random.randint(1,4)
 clusters=[]
 cid=0
 for _ in range(random.randint(0,10)):
  L=random.randint(2,4)
  rng=[]
  for j in range(L):
   lo=random.randint(0,20); hi=random.randint(lo,20); rng.append([lo,hi])
  clusters.append(Cluster(cid,random.randrange(classes),[cid],[cid],rng)); cid+=1
 val=[]
 for c in range(classes):
  for _ in range(random.randint(1,5)):
   L=random.randint(0,8)
   # random no1514 for simplicity
   val.append({'class':c,'values':[random.randint(0,20) for _ in range(L)]})
 spec={'classes':classes,'validation':val}
 threshold=Fraction(random.randint(0,5),random.randint(1,5))
 # avoid zero denom classes? ensure present above
 pipeline._calibrate(spec,clusters,threshold)
 N=[sum(1 for r in val if r['class']==c) for c in range(classes)]
 for cl in clusters:
  hits=[sum(1 for r in val if r['class']==c and brute_hits(cl,cl.rng,r['values'])) for c in range(classes)]
  if cl.hits!=hits:
   print('hits fail',trial,cl.cid,cl.rng,cl.hits,hits,val);raise SystemExit
  cin=Fraction(hits[cl.label],N[cl.label]); cout=max([Fraction(hits[c],N[c]) for c in range(classes) if c!=cl.label],default=Fraction(0))
  score=cin/(cout+Fraction(1,10000))
  if cl.score!=score or cl.kept!=(score>threshold):
   print('score fail');raise SystemExit
else: print('calibration all ok')
